subject: Post-call recap: Redwood integration & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: John Sullivan <john.sullivan@acme.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call recap: Redwood integration & next steps

Hi John -

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap of what we heard and the proposed next steps so we all stay aligned.

Pain points you shared:
- Embeddings/semantic search latency is inconsistent at peak traffic, causing slow UI responses for your customer support product.
- Cost per query with the current setup (self-hosted, mixed GPU) is higher than expected; looking for predictable unit economics.
- Need structured outputs (JSON) from model responses for downstream routing, and reliable function-calling for tool invocation.

Goals we discussed:
- Reduce median query latency for embeddings-based search to <200ms for 95th pct.
- Cut per-query GPU spend by ~30% via batching/quantization and smarter routing.
- Ship a POC with streaming token output + structured output for intent extraction and reranking for Q1 2027.

Product fit / integration notes (high-level):
- SDKs: Our JS + Python SDKs support streaming by default; we can provide a sample that shows incremental UI rendering.
- Function calling: We support explicit function/schema calling and structured JSON outputs you can validate on the client.
- Embeddings/reranking: We can run an embeddings + reranker pipeline; recommend doing offline evals on a representative prompt set first.

Action items / next steps:
1) I will send a short post-call deck with integration notes and an initial proposal (attached).
2) Please share the completed security questionnaire and any SSO/KMS requirements - Rishi will coordinate.
3) Proposed follow-up: 45-min technical deep dive with your infra lead and our runtime engineer - are you available next Wed (Nov 30) 10-11am PT?

Attachments: postcall-deck.pdf (integration summary & timeline)

Thanks - excited to keep this moving.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0132

From: John Sullivan <john.sullivan@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 16:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: Redwood integration & next steps

Marissa -

Appreciate the recap, that aligns with what we discussed. Quick answers and a couple of asks:

- Latency: yes, 95th pct > 500ms in peak windows; we can share traces from the past month.
- Cost: looking at total cost of ownership; can you send a breakout of expected per-token cost for hosted vs. dedicated?
- Security/compliance: we need SOC 2 Type II evidence and details on KMS/HSM options. I attached our security questionnaire - can Rishi take point?

Availability: Wed Nov 30 10-11am PT works for a technical deep dive. Please include an agenda and the runtime engineer.

Thanks -
John Sullivan
Head of Product - Search
Acme Corp
john.sullivan@acme.com | (212) 555-0199

John -

Thanks for the quick responses and for the security questionnaire (received). Rishi will own the security answers - he and the security team will follow up with the SOC2 artifact and KMS details by Tue EOD.

Attached I included a short integration notes doc that maps our SDK and runtime patterns to the specific features you asked about: streaming, function calling, structured outputs, and an embeddings + reranker evaluation plan. High-level timeline:
- Week 1 (Dec 1-7): Tech deep dive + access provisioning for POC.
- Week 2 (Dec 8-14): POC implementation (streaming + function calling + structured output tests).
- Week 3 (Dec 15-21): Evaluation and cost profiling; recommend dedicated pilot if perf meets targets.

Pricing ask: I'll follow up with a model-level cost estimate (hosted vs dedicated) and a sample reserved-capacity quote ahead of the tech deep dive.

Can you confirm the attendee list for Wed so we can lock the calendar?

Best,
Marissa
